in_sanskrit.name: Riyan
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Little King
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Riyan एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Riyan means 'Little King' in Hindu culture. This name is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Raja' which means 'king'. It is a name for a boy who is believed to be born to rule and lead.
